name: Agent Audit Trail
summary: Ed25519-signed execution logs with per-event SHA-512 integrity hashes, attribution fields, and a forensic archive. The existing enterprise_infrastructure logger is the product.
description: Agent Audit Trail sells the signed audit evidence already implemented in `enterprise_infrastructure/comprehensive_audit_logging.py`. Each event gets its own SHA-512 integrity hash and, when signing is enabled, an Ed25519 signature over the event identifier, timestamp, and hash. That is tamper-evident audit evidence, not a blockchain-style predecessor-linked chain. The value is attributable records, signature verification, and exportable audit context.
buyer: A team that has to prove what an agent did — to itself, to counsel, or to an auditor — and cannot rely on mutable application logs alone.

features.name: Per-event integrity hash
features.detail: Each record stores an `immutable_hash` derived from core event fields.

features.name: Ed25519 signing
features.detail: When signing is enabled, the logger signs event identity and integrity material at write time.

features.name: Attributable actions
features.detail: Actor, session, tool, source component, and outcome metadata travel with each record.

features.name: Tamper evidence
features.detail: Changed hashed identity fields or missing signature material are detectable during verification/export review.

features.name: Forensic archive
features.detail: SQLite-backed event storage and alert storage support investigation and retention workflows.

features.name: Compliance export foundation
features.detail: Compliance tags and generated compliance reports provide the reviewer-facing export surface.

source_components.maps_to: comprehensive_audit_logging.py — event hashing, Ed25519 signatures, attribution, storage, and compliance reporting.

readiness.next_action: Sell as the signed, tamper-evident audit layer and pair with AUD-01 for manual reconstruction engagements.
